events.title: Python 3.12 released
events.summary: Python 3.12 arrived on October 2, 2023 with f-string improvements, per-interpreter GIL work, and faster comprehensions.
events.about: Python 3.12 refined f-string parsing (PEP 701), per-interpreter GIL work, and faster comprehensions. The per-interpreter GIL laid groundwork for better multi-core Python — relevant for AI training scripts and web workers.

narrative.whyChosen: 3.12 kept Python's annual improvement cadence while prepping multicore evolution.
narrative.whyImportant: Incremental speed and syntax polish matter at Python's massive scale.
narrative.problemSolved: Developers wanted safer f-strings and faster startup without waiting for Python 4.
